summary: M0 model-only verdict: CONTAIN @ 0.92. Confirmed account takeover for s.demir@aegean.edu (Lab-admin). All 8 sign-ins originate from a single foreign VPS IP (45.142.10.9, Cloudvault, Frankfurt, DE) via the flagged vulnerable appliance vpn-edge-01, with no device_id recorded.
